about: Drives under flake quarantine (test-suite restructure, 2026-11-09; the flake rule lives in tests/TIER-MAP.md). A quarantined drive is removed from the Tier A core set and from Tier B family sets by scripts/select-tier.py: it does not gate the fast tiers until it is hardened and Andrew (or the round that hardens it) removes the entry. It still runs - and still gates - in the Tier C full battery and the nightly battery, where its surface matters most and a flake is handled by the one-focused-re-run rule. Entry requires TWO flake records under the new rule, or a standing record of repeated flakes from the audit sweep.

quarantined.reason: Repeated FLAKE-classified failures in the 2026-11-09 audit sweep (the T3 family across the census-fix round and earlier). Excluded from Tier A gating per the restructure ruling until hardened; its finish/Undo guard coverage lives in drive146 C0/C1b in the meantime, and drive89 itself still runs at Tier C and nightly.

Second quarantine (audit-gate build, 2026-11-11). Record 1: repeated FLAKE-classified failures, quarantined, then hardened (drive156-harden round: in-page rAF morph recorder replacing the CDP sampler) and lifted 2026-11-11 in Beta 1.172. Record 2 (same evening): run 43146565200 (push event, commit 4109dae3) browser-tests shard 7 failed check C1 at 35/36 - the city pane's Back measured 60 px wide in a 342 px pane at press time - while the concurrent PR-event run 43146590273 on the SAME commit passed drive156 36/36, the bridge-branch battery (run 43147382760) passed shard 7, and the one focused re-run of the failed job (run 43146565200 attempt 2) passed 36/36: identical app code, one fail against three passes, classified FLAKE. Excluded from Tier A/B gating until hardened again; still runs and gates in the Tier C full battery and the nightly battery. Record 3 (same night): run 43150186864 (push event, bridge head 399b4c87) shard 7 failed C1 again at 35/36 with the identical measurement signature (w 60, paneW 342), while the PR-event run 43150193376 on the same commit passed the full battery and the push run's focused re-run (attempt 2) passed shard 7 - tally on identical app code: 2 fails against 5 passes, FLAKE. The recurrence pattern is the C1 press landing mid-layout; the next hardening round should give C1 the same terminal-signal wait the earlier drive156 hardening gave the morph flights.
